issues.issue: The bottom disclaimer/source line is very small at 720p and will be difficult to read on broadcast playback.
issues.fix: Increase the footer size or split it into a shorter, larger two-line credit/disclaimer.

issues.issue: The chip 'APPROVED AUTOMATION POLICY (FUTURE)' may read as a future-approved policy without clearly tying it to the proposed Phase B governance requirement.
issues.fix: Change to wording such as 'PROPOSED PHASE B POLICY — REQUIRES GOVERNANCE APPROVAL' or 'APPROVED ONLY AFTER MGMT/SECURITY/CHANGE GOVERNANCE'.

issues.issue: The upstream card says 'baseline hardening' and 'some security & operations agents', which blurs the required lineage boundary between the GovTech/GCC Golden Amazon Linux 2023 source and the Hardened Base OS.
issues.fix: Keep the upstream card to 'GovTech/GCC Golden Amazon Linux 2023 / approved source image' and move hardening/agent-package language to the Hardened Base OS frame.

issues.issue: The inactive GitLab and ECS Worker panels are heavily dimmed; several checklist lines and proposed labels are low-contrast at 720p.
issues.fix: Raise inactive-panel text opacity or use a darker panel background with brighter text while still keeping MongoDB visually dominant.

issues.issue: A horizontal glass/rail line crosses the GitLab checklist area, making the 'data kept after reboot' row visually noisy.
issues.fix: Move the checklist box slightly upward or add a more opaque backing behind the text.

issues.issue: The inactive GitLab and MongoDB panels are very dim; checklist text and the MongoDB proposed badge are hard to read at 720p.
issues.fix: Increase contrast on inactive panels or simplify them to muted headers only, leaving the active ECS Worker panel readable and uncluttered.

issues.issue: The large 'BLOCKED' stamp overlaps the blocker list and obscures parts of 'missing approval' and 'missing snapshot or KMS key access' at 720p.
issues.fix: Move the stamp to the right or below the list, or reduce its size so all blocker text remains fully legible.

issues.issue: The Phase B label says 'future auto-promotion' but does not state the required 'monthly' cadence.
issues.fix: Retitle or add a badge: 'PHASE B — PROPOSED MONTHLY AUTO-PROMOTION'.

issues.issue: The blocker list says 'missing approval' but does not specify the required management/security/change-governance approval of the Phase B policy.
issues.fix: Replace with 'missing management/security/change-governance policy approval' or add a separate explicit policy-approval gate.

issues.issue: The frame says an urgent out-of-band release needs 'explicit Ops approval', which could imply Ops approval alone is sufficient for Phase B exceptions.
issues.fix: Clarify that urgent releases operate under an already approved management/security/change-governance policy, or state 'Ops + change/security approval as required'.

issues.issue: The Phase B label says 'future auto-promotion' but does not state the required monthly cadence.
issues.fix: Use 'PHASE B — PROPOSED MONTHLY AUTO-PROMOTION' or add a visible 'MONTHLY' badge.

review.overall: Most frames respect the illustrative/not-live framing, proposed labels, and three-family lineage. Main fixes are to keep upstream vs Hardened Base OS claims separated, make Phase B explicitly 'proposed monthly auto-promotion' with governance-policy approval, and improve 720p legibility where dimmed panels or overlays obscure text.
